items.statement: A valid investigation documents relaxation and identifies the resulting adsorption geometry rather than assuming the initial site remains fixed.
items.expected: Submission provides geometry/convergence evidence and an unambiguous final adsorption-site description.

items.statement: A valid pDOS assignment uses sulfur/Au-bond projections and EF alignment and discriminates the hybrid feature from other Au states.
items.expected: Submission documents an independent feature-discrimination procedure with projection and alignment evidence.

items.statement: The source-supported occupied Au-S hybrid feature occurs around 1 eV below EF.
items.expected: Reported energy_relative_to_fermi_eV is approximately -1.0 eV, with uncertainty and method dependence disclosed.
